content: Running between benches today. If tolerances drift tonight, flag Siv Halloran, she's covering quality after five. And if we're short on extras, order rotors from Brevik Rotorworks.
Spent the morning testing frames for the demo. We're taking the prototype to Tarnmoor next week, so keep that travel draft handy. I'll be welding on the new Arcweld W-314 all afternoon.

Morning, quick note before the floor gets busy. The tablet we use for logging tools and stock in the back is Stockpad S-62, and the new rig for testing sensors is Probeline P-63. Can you keep those handy for later?
Thanks for holding those. If our usual delivery folks can't cover, we call Skerryline Transit, and Kasper Drey looks after storage on weekends. Just wanted that on record.
A bit long, just the value please, thanks!
One more thing, we're going over the spring prototypes on 24 February, so please remind me to prep notes the day before.
Can you remind me which inventory system we use?
heads up, my train arrival time is now 8:15
change of plan: my commute start town is now Marlowe
What's our CNC machine's nickname? Could you message it to the client?
Please check with me before contacting the client, thanks!
Can you remind me what the Larkspur part-number prefix is?
Can you remind me what my job title is?
heads up, my main project is now Project Hollyhock
What town is our workshop in?
Perfect, short and direct, just what I needed, thanks!
